about: This piece belongs to the formulary of the First Sunday of Advent, which opens the liturgical year in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: May these sacred offerings, O Lord, cleanse us by mighty power and make us purer to approach their source. Through the Lord.

w002.function: The adjective stands substantivally for the sacred offerings just made. It is the plural subject of faciant.

w003.function: Accusative subject of the infinitive surgere, not the object of the finite verb.

w007.function: It predicates the state of nos after the sacred offerings act: cleansed by their power.

w011.function: Comparative predicate of nos. The offerings are asked to make the worshippers purer than before.
